notify.heading: Notifications.
notify.message: Notifications arrive on this device. Nothing else has anything to announce yet.

outcome.sent: Sent. Some devices do not draw one while this window is the one in front.
outcome.refused: This device does not permit notifications from Almena.
outcome.failed: It could not be sent, and this build cannot say why.

peers.heading: Peers
peers.noNetwork: This node is on no network.
peers.none: This node is on a network and is talking to nobody on it.
peers.lookedAt: Looked at {{time}}, and again every ten seconds.

control.heading: Running this node
control.zone: Zone, or empty for this network's own
control.joinTheMesh: Take a place on the mesh
control.carriedBy: Relay to be carried by, or empty to be dialled directly
control.challengeShown: Show this to whoever contributed the node.
control.certificate: Certificate (PEM), or nothing to answer in the clear

reason.alreadyOnANetwork: This node is already on a network.
reason.noRandomness: The system would not produce randomness, so there is no key to be.
reason.noClock: The system would not say what time it is, and a network has to record when its first epoch began.
reason.noDirectory: This computer would not say where the node keeps things, so it has nowhere to be a node.
reason.unreadableIdentity: There is a key in the node's directory and it cannot be read.
reason.recordWouldNotStart: The record would not take the acts that start it, so the network was not opened.
reason.formatIsNotFrozen: The format this build writes is not one a network may be opened on for good, so nothing was opened.
reason.unreadableRecord: There is a record in the node's directory and it cannot be read.
reason.recordDoesNotAddUp: The record no longer holds everything this node has already signed for.
reason.directoryHeld: Another node is already running on this directory.
reason.directoryCannotBeHeld: This filesystem will not say whether another node is using the directory.
reason.noCertificate: The certificate file is not there, cannot be read, or holds no certificate.
reason.noPrivateKey: The private key is not there, cannot be read, or holds no key.
reason.certificateAndKeyAreNotAPair: That key does not belong to that certificate.
reason.zoneSilent: The zone did not answer, so whether anybody is already there is unknown.
reason.thereIsANetwork: The zone says there is already a network.
reason.notThePromisedNetwork: Somebody listed as being on this network turned out to be on another one, or to be passing off one they made up.
reason.noTransport: This machine would not give the node a way onto the mesh at all.
reason.meshAddressUnavailable: That port could not be listened on — usually somebody else already has it.
reason.noNetwork: There is no network to serve yet.
reason.notAClaim: That is not a challenge and an approval of it.
reason.notTheirs: It read, and it does not bind: the approval is not signed by the key their own record authorises, or the challenge had stopped being good.
reason.notWrittenDown: The record would not take it, which should not be reachable.
reason.addressUnavailable: Nothing could listen on that address.
reason.unknown: It did not work, and this build has no reading for what came back.
reason.noNetworkYet: There is no network yet: nobody is there to join, and nothing was opened.
reason.governmentKeyNotKept: The government's key could not be kept beside the record, so nothing was opened.
reason.nobodyIsThereIsForDevelopment: Production is opened on the zone's word and never on yours.

control.closeThisNodeArmed: Press again. It does not come back.

published.title: What this node publishes
published.body: Where it can be reached, and where the interface describes itself.

empty.notBundled: The agent is built from its own repository and staged into the bundle, and this build was made without one.
empty.notStarted: The agent has not been started.
empty.willNotStart: It is in this build and it would not run.
empty.stopped: It was running and it is not now. Asking something else starts a fresh one.

conversation.adopted: Answering a question asked before this page opened. What it says cannot be shown here.

error.heading: That did not work.
error.agent_will_not_start: The agent would not start, so there was nothing to ask.
error.agent_stopped: The agent stopped part-way, so the answer never finished.
error.run_already_in_flight: The agent is already answering something. It does one thing at a time.
error.model_unreachable: Nothing answered at the model's address.
error.model_unknown: That address is serving, and it does not serve the model chosen in Settings.
error.resource_unknown: The agent was asked for something it does not hold.
error.unknown: The agent refused, and this build has no words for the reason it gave.

openAtLogin.heading: Open at login.
openAtLogin.label: Open Almena at login
openAtLogin.refused: The system did not accept the change, so the setting stays as it was.

model.heading: Model.
model.label: Model the agent asks for
model.inForceNone: Running now: nothing. The agent starts when you first ask it something.
model.restartHeading: This applies the next time the agent starts.

cli.recordsNone: Not being written to a file. This node has nowhere it may keep one.

onboarding.title: Which network
onboarding.lead: The one decision worth asking for. Everything after it, this node does by itself.

production.title: Production
production.body: The network. What is signed here stands, and does not come undone.

development.title: Development
development.body: Where something is tried before it is real. Opened afresh whenever the format moves.

says.alreadyOnANetwork: This node is already on a network.
says.zoneSilent: The zone did not answer, so nobody knows who is there.
says.nobodyIsThere: Nobody is on that network yet.
says.noTransport: This node could not take a place on the mesh.
says.seedUnreachable: The node named in the zone could not be reached.
says.seedWouldNotAnswer: The node named in the zone would not hand over the record.
says.notThePromisedNetwork: What came back is not the network the zone named.
says.recordDoesNotAddUp: What came back does not add up.
says.unreadableRecord: What came back could not be read.
says.noDirectory: This node's directory could not be written to.
says.directoryHeld: Another process is holding this node's directory.
says.noRandomness: The system would not produce randomness.
says.unreadableIdentity: This node's key could not be read.
says.somethingElse: It did not work, and this build has no words for why. The reason is in the records.
says.thereIsANetwork: The zone names somebody, so there is a network to join rather than one to open.
says.formatIsNotFrozen: This build's format is still moving, and a production network must not open on one that is. Nothing was written.
says.recordWouldNotStart: This node's record could not be started.
says.noClock: The system clock could not be read, and a network's beginning is the one wall clock reading this platform writes down.
says.directoryCannotBeHeld: It could not be told whether another process is holding this node's directory.
says.theZoneIsUnreadable: That network's zone publishes a seed record this build cannot read, so there is nobody to join — and nothing can be opened either, because something is published. The zone has to be corrected before any node can come up on it.
says.meshAddressUnavailable: The mesh port could not be listened on. Usually somebody else has it.
says.addressUnavailable: Nothing could listen on the interface address.
says.governmentKeyNotKept: The government's key could not be kept beside the record, so nothing was opened.
says.nobodyIsThereIsForDevelopment: Production is opened on the zone's word and never on yours.

claim.title: Who contributed this node
claim.body: Scanning signs, from your own device, that this node is yours. It is optional — an unclaimed node works the same, it just credits nobody.
claim.none: No code: this node could not make a challenge.
claim.expires: Good for {{hours}} hour. After that, ask for another from the Network screen.

advanced.zone: Zone, or empty for this network's own
advanced.seed: A seed record, or empty to ask the zone
advanced.nobodyIsThere: Nobody is there: open development without asking the zone
